reference_description: The pie chart illustrates the distribution of ambiguity by showing two sets of data: "Ambiguity Std" represented in the outer ring and "Max Ambiguity" in the inner ring, each with several categories. The outer ring is divided into four categories: "Std: 0.0" in dark blue comprising 49.0%, "Std: 0.47" in medium blue at 38.0%, "Std: 0.82" in light blue comprising 5.0%, and "Std: 0.94" in very light blue making up 7.0%. The inner ring contains three categories: "Max: 1" in medium blue representing 47.7%, "Max: 2" in light blue at 39.0%, and "Max: 3" in very light blue comprising 14.2%. A legend is included for each ring separately, which helps in identifying the colors corresponding to each category. The chart includes percentage labels inside the slices for clarity, and the segments appear to be arranged in descending order of size within each ring.
